analysis.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy affair scandal and lawsuits
analysis.summary: Congress summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia opened an investigation, lawsuits followed, and further affairs were later reported. Huang resigned as CEO, Colette Kress became interim chief, and one report put Nvidia's market value loss at over $1 trillion within a month.
